title: Physical-device evidence archive authenticity / tamper-evident capture bundle hardening
purpose: Make post-capture replacement, omission, role swapping and run-inventory manipulation detectable across W22/W26/W23/W25/W24 evidence without claiming cryptographic device attestation.
integrity_controls: exact artifact role, normalized relative path, SHA-256 and byte length
4 mandatory per-run roles for every planned run
decoded role/content cross-binding to W22/W26/W24/W25 policies
build and physical-device corroboration consistency records
fail-closed missing, extra, duplicate, traversal, role swap, hash, length and root checks

adversarial_cases: deterministic root independent of entry order

stress_validation.note: Evaluator/archive hashing overhead only; not physical-iPhone Analysis performance evidence.

limitations: No physical iPhone was executed in W27.
An attacker able to replace both archived artifacts and an unanchored archive manifest can recompute a new internally consistent root.
W27 provides no secret-key signature, Secure Enclave proof, Apple attestation, trusted timestamp or hardware-origin guarantee.
Build/device corroboration remains self-consistency evidence until HQ independently archives and anchors the final root.
Source-loader truth and actual source-file acquisition remain outside Worker 4 ownership.
MOI-P021 and final PARITY remain HQ Late Integration decisions.
